source.note: The noise window sends a non-RNAV prop off runway 01 on the runway heading with no departure procedure (SFOW-NOISE-P-RWY, SFO ATCT SOP 2-4 e), so the clearance names no SID: the procedure element is the heading and the route element is the airport's no-SID phrasing on the first filed fix (R-HEADING; FAA JO 7110.65 4-3-2 c 3).
